raw.rationale: This launched antihypertensive is a broad serotonin/dopamine/adrenergic receptor antagonist with no known cytotoxic mechanism at 2.5 µM, and PRISM screens of such GPCR-targeted drugs rarely show lineage-selective killing beyond base rates. Any apparent selectivity would likely reflect lineage-specific expression of HTR/ADRA/DRD receptors or SLC18A1/2, but without published cytotoxic PRISM evidence the probabilities remain near the 0.2–2.5% base rate.
